name: @marktripoli/skills
description: Portable agent skills for research, design, planning, implementation, and pull request delivery

scripts.test: node scripts/validate.mjs && node scripts/sync-plugin.mjs --check && node --test tests/*.test.mjs skills/delivery/jev-ui/scripts/test-acceptance.mjs && npm run test:safety-dance && npm run test:slack-coordinator
scripts.test:safety-dance: node scripts/check-safety-dance-identity.mjs && (cd tools/safety-dance && go test -race ./... && go vet ./... && tmp=$(mktemp -d) && trap "rm -rf \"$tmp\"" EXIT && go build -o "$tmp/safety-dance" ./cmd/safety-dance && make e2e) && node --test tests/safety-dance-release.test.mjs
scripts.test:slack-coordinator: cd tools/slack-coordinator && go test -race ./... && go vet ./... && tmp=$(mktemp -d) && trap "rm -rf \"$tmp\"" EXIT && go build -o "$tmp/slack-coordinator" ./cmd/slack-coordinator
